en: New Register entry: you can now create a new account right from the sign-in screen.
zh: 新增注册入口：登录界面就能注册新账号。

en: Version 2.0.0: a new Forum entry in the app — tap “Forum” in the toolbar to open it.
The device page gains a privacy-lock switch: it works once the companion component on the controlled computer is deployed (the component is rolling out with this release).
A batch of prompts has been shortened and smoothed out, so everything reads more clearly.
zh: 大版本 2.0.0：软件里新增论坛入口，点工具栏的「论坛」就能进论坛。
设备页新增隐私锁开关：被控电脑组件部署完成后即可使用（组件正在随版下发）。
一批提示文案改短改顺，读起来更清楚。

en: A brand-new logo: a blue broken ring with an orange dot, now the same on the Windows app, the Android app and the console.
No functional changes in this release.
zh: 换上了全新品牌标志——蓝色断环加一个橙色圆点的新图标，电脑版、手机版、网页控制台都统一换新。
这一版功能和之前完全一样，没有变化。

en: Friends are here: tap “Friends” in the toolbar, search by account name and send a request — once the other side accepts, you are friends.

Share a group of your computers with a friend for help: view-only by default (see the screen, no control); whether to allow control is your choice when you share. Remove the friend and the sharing is withdrawn automatically, right away.
Friends can chat with end-to-end encryption — the server never sees the plaintext. The friends list also carries an official support contact, answered by the site owner in person.
Android is updated to 1.0.5 in step: friends, sharing and chat included, and in-app update checks are wired up.
Everything from before is still here: in-app updates, relentless auto-reconnect, one-click diagnostics copy, and all the shortcuts.
zh: 软件里多了「好友」：工具栏点「好友」就能打开，按对方账号搜到人、发申请，对方同意后就是好友。
把自己的一组电脑共享给好友请他帮忙：默认「只看」（能看屏幕、不能动手），要不要给「能操作」，由你分享的时候自己选；删掉好友，共享立刻自动收回。
好友之间可以聊天，内容全程加密，服务器上也看不到原文；好友列表里还有官方客服，站长本人回复。
安卓版同步更新到 1.0.5：好友、共享、聊天都有，软件内更新检查也已接通。
之前的功能都在：软件内更新、断线自动重连、诊断信息一键复制、快捷键照旧。

en: New update rules: while the app is running, a new version only shows a reminder and never interrupts you. The next time you reopen the app after closing it, the new version installs first, with a progress bar and an automatic integrity check. If the server is unreachable when you open the app, you can still get in and use it; the app never locks you out.
The About panel now has a Register New Account button and a short explanation of the update rules.

Everything from before is still here: in-app update checks with verified downloads, one-click diagnostics copy, shortcuts (F5 refresh, F9 screenshot, F10 always-on-top, F11 fullscreen), and relentless auto-reconnect.
zh: 更新规矩变了：软件开着的时候查到新版只提醒、不打断你用；等你关掉软件下次再打开，会先把新版装好再进。装的时候有进度条，装完自动核对完整性。要是打开软件时连不上服务器，照样先进去用，不锁软件。
「关于」里多了「注册新账号」按钮和一段更新规矩说明，注册账号更方便。
之前的功能都在：软件内检查更新、下载核对、诊断信息一键复制、快捷键（F5 刷新、F9 截图、F10 置顶、F11 全屏）、断线自动重连。

en: In-app updates are here: the app checks for new versions on launch and from the About panel; a download is verified before you are asked to install it.
About panel: copy diagnostics in one click, so a problem report carries everything needed.
New shortcuts: F5 refresh, F9 screenshot, F10 always-on-top, F11 fullscreen.
zh: 软件内更新上线：打开软件自动检查新版本，「关于」里也能手动检查；新版下载后先核对完整性，对得上才提示安装。
「关于」新增一键复制诊断信息，出了问题把诊断发过来就能定位。
快捷键补齐：F5 刷新、F9 截图、F10 置顶、F11 全屏。

en: Dual toolbar themes: switch between bright blue and deep gray in one click — splash, loading and offline screens follow.
New server status light in the toolbar: see at a glance whether the server is reachable, with the latest check result and time.
One-click screenshot: save the current console view as an image.
Completed About panel: version, build date, and a server status self-check button.
zh: 工具栏新增双主题：亮蓝与深灰一键切换，启动、加载、断线页面跟随变色。
工具栏新增服务器状态灯：服务器通不通一眼可见，点开可看最近一次检测结果与时间。
新增一键截图：当前控制台画面一键存成图片。
「关于」面板补全：版本号、构建日期、服务器状态自检按钮。

en: Full visual redesign: new icon, bright-blue gradient toolbar, glass-card screens.
Two-layer auto-reconnect: full-page drops retry on a countdown; session drops reconnect automatically — unlimited retries, no pop-ups, never bounced back to the sign-in page.
New fullscreen mode, page zoom with percentage display, and always-on-top.
The app remembers window size and position; launching it again just brings the existing window forward.
zh: 界面整体重做：新图标、亮蓝渐变工具栏、玻璃卡片式页面。
断线自动重连双保险：整页断开自动倒计时重试；会话断开自动重新连接，不限次数、不弹窗打扰、不踢回登录页。
新增全屏、页面缩放（带百分比显示）、窗口置顶。
软件会记住窗口大小与位置；重复打开只唤起已有窗口，不再开一堆。

en: The first QFRemote Windows app: double-click to open the console directly — no browser, no certificate warnings.
Sign in once and it is remembered; later launches go straight in.
Own brand icon and toolbar; the server address is baked into the app, so it only ever connects to our own server — much harder to spoof.
zh: QFRemote 首个 Windows 软件版：双击打开直接进入控制台，不用再开浏览器、不用再点证书警告。
登录一次即可记住，之后打开免登录。
自家品牌图标与工具栏；服务器地址写死在软件里，只连自家服务器，更防假冒。
